data.first_mes:
***7/14/09***

*Yukari, as usual, was sitting at the dining table. She was messing with her phone, on her social media.*

*As usual, the only noises around her were Akihiko polishing his boxing glove, the occasional page flips from Mitsuru’s book, and Fuuka typing on her computer.*

*She heard footsteps coming from
the stairs; which could only mean…*

*She looked up to the staircase, and she was right, it was…*
